blinding_guess.why: Kobuki::init passes only parameters.enable_acceleration_limiter to acceleration_limiter.init (kobuki.cpp:112), so the Parameters fields linear/angular_acceleration/deceleration_limit (parameters.hpp:47-50,62-65; defaults 0.3/-0.36/3.5/-4.2) are silently ignored and the limiter keeps its own defaults (0.5/-0.6/3.5/-4.2, acceleration_limiter.hpp:57-59); secondary suspects: getHeading ignores the imu_heading_offset that resetOdometry sets (diff_drive.cpp:112, never read), and updateOdometry uses encoders only although the docs say it fuses gyro heading

notes: Non-ROS pure C++ library (ros_generation 'other', ros_distro null); the snapshot holds the whole kobuki repository and only snapshot/kobuki_driver was described. All ten packet elements are public member functions of class kobuki::Kobuki declared in include/kobuki_driver/kobuki.hpp and all are provided; none is consumed, so references is empty (the code depends on ecl_* library symbols such as ecl::Angle, ecl::Pose2D, ecl::linear_algebra::Vector3d, ecl::StandardException, ecl::Serial, which are not packet elements and were not enumerated). msg_type, definition_id and QoS are null throughout: these are C++ API symbols with no ROS message/service/action/idl definition and no middleware QoS. Frames: none of the accessors declares a coordinate frame; frame is 'none' only for init (no data), getCurrentData (motor currents) and getGpInputData (digital/analog pin values); null for heading, angular velocity, inertia, odometry, cliff, dock IR and core sensor data (spatial or mixed, frame undeclared). Units: getAngularVelocity recorded as rad/s from the deg-to-rad conversion of Inertia::Data::angle_rate (the code comment says only 'convert to radians'; per-second is from the function/field meaning). updateOdometry units left null: pose_update/pose_update_rates units are not stated, though DiffDrive kinematics use wheel_radius 0.035 and bias 0.23 'in [m]' (diff_drive.cpp:35-36) and a firmware timestamp divided by 1000 (diff_drive.cpp:92). Cliff and current units come from the protocol appendix in the snapshot doxygen; the appendix lists motor-current fields as size 2 with Length 2 whereas current.hpp reads one uint8_t per motor. rate_hz null: the code sets no rate; the protocol doc (en_appendix_protocol.dox:312) says the robot streams default feedback at 50 Hz, a firmware property, and the driver's spin loop is driven by incoming data. exclusive empty: the driver opens the serial device parameters.device_port (default "/dev/kobuki", parameters.hpp:40) via ecl::Serial but nothing in the snapshot declares the handle exclusive. Declaration strings copy the header lines verbatim, including inline bodies for the raw-data accessors; updateOdometry spans two lines (128-129) collapsed to one.
